repeatability.method: Compile, independently verify, then rerun the identical compiler invocation with --check after final schema/verifier fixes and LF normalization of compiler authorities.

authored-hint.message: Exact candidate feedback remains in the source; the app derives shared hints. Verify each actual error against shared teaching support; candidate text is not runtime evidence or automatic approval.

authored-instruction.message: Exact instruction_es remains in the source; the app derives shared instructions. Compare intended task meaning with that shared behavior, rather than assuming every custom instruction must become an app field.

canonical-answer-audio.message: Backend derives fallback answer assets that newer mobile Recognize/Listen playback intentionally omits. Reconcile that unused inventory in shared binding/cache; do not generate additional spoken content or substitute voices.

clock.message: The projection does not represent retained clock/time evidence. Review it against the approved teaching and assessment boundaries and resolve its shared representation before installation.

construction-reply.message: The projection cannot play the authored next dialogue reply after constructing the target. It remains in the exact source; resolve the supported sequencing before installation.

image-bundling.message: Some retained image formats are unsupported by the current offline exporter; review a shared rendering/bundling solution before installation.

prepared-pronunciation-delivery.message: Canonical audio schema does not represent the prepared delivery profile or its source receipt. Preserve exact per-occurrence audioDelivery, audioReceipt, voice and checksum bindings from the authoritative source sidecars before app integration; the supported projection is not an installation receipt.

required-canonical-audio.message: Some player-required canonical assets lack exact source recordings, including any newly authored mission briefing. These are explicit missing bindings; the package cannot be installed.

runtime-review.message: Native/web parity and human semantic/audio approval are pending; this local package does not establish them.

turn-translation.message: Current canonical schema has only card-level translation; retain exact per-turn translations in delivery sidecar.
